name: ACP
description: Any Agent Client Protocol agent (Zed's ACP: JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio), mapped onto the runner protocol. Verified with Google's Gemini CLI (`gemini --experimental-acp`); other ACP agents run through a custom command. Questions ride session/request_permission, file paths resolve inside the workspace, and terminal commands are only started with a workspace cwd.

requires.image: glibc + node >= 20 + the pinned @google/gemini-cli on PATH (npm install -g @google/gemini-cli) for the gemini preset

agent.title: ACP agent
agent.description: Which ACP agent to launch. `gemini` is the verified one: Google's Gemini CLI in its ACP mode (`gemini --experimental-acp`), authenticated with the GEMINI_API_KEY secret for generativelanguage.googleapis.com. `custom` launches any other ACP agent through the command below — declare its API hosts and credential in your deployment, since this manifest only declares Gemini's.

command.title: Custom command
command.description: Used when the ACP agent is `custom`: the full command line including arguments, e.g. `grok agent stdio` (unverified) or `node /opt/acp-agent/main.js --stdio`. Quote spans with single or double quotes to keep arguments with spaces whole.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model id sent to the agent with session/set_model after session/new. Only applied when the agent advertises model selection at session/new; otherwise the agent's own default runs and a warning is logged. A Gemini CLI configured with GEMINI_API_KEY picks its model with the same setting's default.
